name: Internal Audit Report
report_script:
result = []

company = filters.get("company")
from_date = filters.get("from_date")
to_date = filters.get("to_date")

conditions = "company = %(company)s"
values = {"company": company}
if from_date:
    conditions += " and posting_date >= %(from_date)s"
    values["from_date"] = from_date
if to_date:
    conditions += " and posting_date <= %(to_date)s"
    values["to_date"] = to_date

# 1. Stock Reconciliation adjustments
recon_conditions = conditions.replace("posting_date", "posting_date")
recons = frappe.db.sql(f"""
    select name, posting_date, owner
    from `tabStock Reconciliation`
    where docstatus = 1 and {recon_conditions}
""", values, as_dict=True)
for r in recons:
    result.append({
        "category": "Stock Reconciliation",
        "reference": r.name,
        "date": r.posting_date,
        "details": "Physical stock count adjustment",
        "amount": 0,
        "user": r.owner
    })

# 2. Cancelled Sales Invoices
cancelled = frappe.db.sql(f"""
    select name, posting_date, grand_total, owner
    from `tabSales Invoice`
    where docstatus = 2 and {conditions}
""", values, as_dict=True)
for c in cancelled:
    result.append({
        "category": "Cancelled Sales Invoice",
        "reference": c.name,
        "date": c.posting_date,
        "details": "Invoice was cancelled after creation",
        "amount": c.grand_total,
        "user": c.owner
    })

# 3. Manual Journal Entries (not auto-generated from other transactions)
je_conditions = conditions
journals = frappe.db.sql(f"""
    select name, posting_date, total_debit, owner, voucher_type
    from `tabJournal Entry`
    where docstatus = 1 and voucher_type = 'Journal Entry' and {je_conditions}
""", values, as_dict=True)
for j in journals:
    result.append({
        "category": "Manual Journal Entry",
        "reference": j.name,
        "date": j.posting_date,
        "details": "Manually posted journal entry",
        "amount": j.total_debit,
        "user": j.owner
    })

# 4. Payment Entries with no invoice reference
payments = frappe.db.sql(f"""
    select pe.name, pe.posting_date, pe.paid_amount, pe.owner
    from `tabPayment Entry` pe
    where pe.docstatus = 1 and pe.company = %(company)s
    and not exists (select 1 from `tabPayment Entry Reference` per where per.parent = pe.name)
    {"and pe.posting_date >= %(from_date)s" if from_date else ""}
    {"and pe.posting_date <= %(to_date)s" if to_date else ""}
""", values, as_dict=True)
for p in payments:
    result.append({
        "category": "Unlinked Payment Entry",
        "reference": p.name,
        "date": p.posting_date,
        "details": "Payment with no linked invoice reference",
        "amount": p.paid_amount,
        "user": p.owner
    })

columns = [
    {"label": "Category", "fieldname": "category", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180},
    {"label": "Reference", "fieldname": "reference", "fieldtype": "Dynamic Link", "options": "category", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Date", "fieldname": "date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 100},
    {"label": "Details", "fieldname": "details", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 250},
    {"label": "Amount", "fieldname": "amount", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
    {"label": "User", "fieldname": "user", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
]

name: VAT Report
report_script:
result = []

company = filters.get("company")
if not company:
    frappe.throw("Please select a Company")
from_date = filters.get("from_date")
to_date = filters.get("to_date")

company_abbr = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company, "abbr")
vat_account = f"VAT - {company_abbr}"

sales = frappe.db.sql("""
    select si.name, si.posting_date, si.customer, si.net_total, sit.tax_amount
    from `tabSales Invoice` si
    inner join `tabSales Taxes and Charges` sit on sit.parent = si.name
    where si.docstatus = 1
    and si.company = %(company)s
    and si.posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
    and sit.account_head = %(vat_account)s
""", {"company": company, "from_date": from_date, "to_date": to_date, "vat_account": vat_account}, as_dict=True)

total_output_vat = 0
total_taxable_sales = 0
for s in sales:
    total_output_vat += s.tax_amount or 0
    total_taxable_sales += s.net_total or 0
    result.append({
        "type": "Output VAT (Sales)",
        "reference": s.name,
        "date": s.posting_date,
        "party": s.customer,
        "taxable_amount": s.net_total,
        "vat_amount": s.tax_amount
    })

purchases = frappe.db.sql("""
    select pi.name, pi.posting_date, pi.supplier, pi.net_total, pit.tax_amount
    from `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
    inner join `tabPurchase Taxes and Charges` pit on pit.parent = pi.name
    where pi.docstatus = 1
    and pi.company = %(company)s
    and pi.posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
    and pit.account_head = %(vat_account)s
""", {"company": company, "from_date": from_date, "to_date": to_date, "vat_account": vat_account}, as_dict=True)

total_input_vat = 0
total_taxable_purchases = 0
for p in purchases:
    total_input_vat += p.tax_amount or 0
    total_taxable_purchases += p.net_total or 0
    result.append({
        "type": "Input VAT (Purchase)",
        "reference": p.name,
        "date": p.posting_date,
        "party": p.supplier,
        "taxable_amount": p.net_total,
        "vat_amount": p.tax_amount
    })

net_vat = total_output_vat - total_input_vat
result.append({
    "type": "--- SUMMARY ---",
    "reference": "",
    "date": "",
    "party": f"Taxable Sales: {total_taxable_sales} | Taxable Purchases: {total_taxable_purchases}",
    "taxable_amount": None,
    "vat_amount": None
})
result.append({
    "type": "Net VAT Payable" if net_vat >= 0 else "Net VAT Refundable",
    "reference": "",
    "date": "",
    "party": "",
    "taxable_amount": None,
    "vat_amount": abs(net_vat)
})

columns = [
    {"label": "Type", "fieldname": "type", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180},
    {"label": "Reference", "fieldname": "reference", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Date", "fieldname": "date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 100},
    {"label": "Party", "fieldname": "party", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 220},
    {"label": "Taxable Amount", "fieldname": "taxable_amount", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 130},
    {"label": "VAT Amount (13%)", "fieldname": "vat_amount", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 130},
]

name: IBA Customer Ledger
report_script:
columns = [
    {"label": "Date", "fieldname": "date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 110},
    {"label": "Particulars", "fieldname": "particulars", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 250},
    {"label": "Voucher No", "fieldname": "reference", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Debit", "fieldname": "debit", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
    {"label": "Credit", "fieldname": "credit", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
    {"label": "Balance", "fieldname": "balance", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
]
result = []
customer = filters.get("customer")
from_date = filters.get("from_date")
to_date = filters.get("to_date")
company = filters.get("company")

if customer and from_date and to_date and company:
    opening = frappe.db.sql("""
        select sum(debit) as debit, sum(credit) as credit
        from `tabGL Entry`
        where party_type='Customer' and party=%(customer)s and company=%(company)s
        and posting_date < %(from_date)s and is_cancelled=0
    """, {"customer": customer, "from_date": from_date, "company": company}, as_dict=True)[0]

    opening_balance = frappe.utils.flt(opening.debit) - frappe.utils.flt(opening.credit)
    result.append({"date": None, "particulars": "Opening Balance", "reference": "", "debit": 0, "credit": 0, "balance": opening_balance})

    txns = frappe.db.sql("""
        select posting_date, voucher_type, voucher_no, debit, credit
        from `tabGL Entry`
        where party_type='Customer' and party=%(customer)s and company=%(company)s
        and posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s and is_cancelled=0
        order by posting_date asc
    """, {"customer": customer, "from_date": from_date, "to_date": to_date, "company": company}, as_dict=True)

    running = opening_balance
    total_debit = 0
    total_credit = 0
    for t in txns:
        running += frappe.utils.flt(t.debit) - frappe.utils.flt(t.credit)
        total_debit += frappe.utils.flt(t.debit)
        total_credit += frappe.utils.flt(t.credit)
        result.append({
            "date": t.posting_date,
            "particulars": t.voucher_type,
            "reference": t.voucher_no,
            "debit": frappe.utils.flt(t.debit),
            "credit": frappe.utils.flt(t.credit),
            "balance": running
        })

    result.append({"date": None, "particulars": "TOTAL", "reference": "", "debit": total_debit, "credit": total_credit, "balance": running})
